visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen comparison: the top half shows a dated, stained bathroom with a beige sink and yellowing countertops, while the bottom half shows a clean, renovated bathroom with bright green-tinted glass wall panels and a modern white toilet. (2) The camera moves to a medium shot of a young man with short, styled hair wearing a black long-sleeved shirt, being interviewed by a woman in a grey hoodie and khaki cap holding a microphone with the 'HahaTai' logo in an indoor studio-like setting. (3) Close-up shots focus on specific bathroom details: a white Panasonic bidet toilet seat, a small white pedestal sink with a gold-colored faucet, and vertical glass panels on the walls. (4) A quick montage shows the man in a blue shirt and work gloves applying sealant and mounting the large glass panels onto the bathroom wall. (5) Back to the interview, the woman points a microphone and then her finger towards the glass panels, highlighting small imperfections like excess sealant or gaps at the seams. (6) The man demonstrates a wall-mounted soap dispenser and the showerhead while explaining his design choices. (7) The final shot shows the man smiling during the interview with variety-style text overlays appearing around him.
